_note: A first run on any machine with two cores and no GPU: two GPU tasks on invented GPU slots (fake mode) and a CPU sidecar, each printing where the launcher put it, then exiting after two seconds. The tasks run in the folder you start from (no cwd). Run, from the repository: python3 pack_node.py --spec examples/specs/local-demo.json --receipt-dir /tmp/ganymede-demo --mode fake --fake-gpus 2 --reserve-cores 0; then read /tmp/ganymede-demo/receipt.md.

gpu_tasks.name: train-a
gpu_tasks.cmd: python3 -c "import os, time; print('training', os.environ['PACK_TASK'], 'in slot', repr(os.environ['PACK_SLOT']), 'on cores', os.environ['PACK_CORES'], flush=True); time.sleep(2); print('done', flush=True)"

gpu_tasks.name: train-b
gpu_tasks.cmd: python3 -c "import os, time; print('training', os.environ['PACK_TASK'], 'in slot', repr(os.environ['PACK_SLOT']), 'on cores', os.environ['PACK_CORES'], flush=True); time.sleep(2); print('done', flush=True)"

cpu_tasks.name: evaluate
cpu_tasks.cmd: python3 -c "import os, time; print('evaluating', os.environ['PACK_TASK'], 'in slot', repr(os.environ['PACK_SLOT']), 'on cores', os.environ['PACK_CORES'], flush=True); time.sleep(2); print('done', flush=True)"
